messages:
emi: Heads-up — release pipeline stopped on npm publish because regen produced a types-only reorder. root file: packages/sdk/src/generated/models.ts

build-bot: CI: release/sdk v2.8.0 pipeline failed — regen-diff detected in packages/sdk/src/generated/models.ts

rahul: paste from regendiff:
```
- export interface Account { id: string; email?: string; createdAt?: string }
+ export interface Account { email?: string; createdAt?: string; id: string }
```
olivia: we've seen similar nondet behaviour when optional props are appended in different branches of codegen. It flips depending on insertion order of property emitters.

emi: quick mitigation: pin codegen/typegen versions in the workspace and normalize gen files in a post-regen hook. Which is less risky for the release?

rahul: pinning is fastest for this single cut. Normalizer is better long-term. If we pin, make sure CI lockfile matches exactly.

olivia: I pushed branch fix/pin-codegen-and-normalize that pins @redwood/codegen@3.4.2 and adds scripts/normalize-generated.js which stable-sorts object keys in generated files. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/672

build-bot: CI started for PR #672 — running regen smoke and full test matrix.

emi: tiny ask: include a regen smoke check that runs regen twice and fails if the workspace isn't idempotent. That catches these flakiness issues earlier.

rahul: added regen-idempotency job in CI YAML. It runs the regen command twice and compares git status. If any changes, it fails. Also added a unit test for normalize-generated.

build-bot: CI passed for PR #672.

release: re-run release pipeline now that PR is merged.

build-bot: Release pipeline retried — publish step now succeeded. SDK v2.8.0 published.

emi: filing follow-ups: 1) RFC to add deterministic key ordering into typegen (short-term), 2) audit all workspace package.jsons for codegen pinning policy, 3) consider excluding pure ordering-only diffs from automatic semver bumps in release-stamp (needs product sign-off).

olivia: I'll draft the RFC and tag relevant owners. rahul, can you open a ticket to audit workspaces?

rahul: on it. created ticket INF-1423 and linked PRs.

emi: thanks team, closing this thread — release unblocked. :party_parrot:
